workspace.title: Finance
workspace.description: Planning and financial structure for your organisation.

structure.pageDescription: Manage reporting groups and accounts for your organisation — no amounts or postings.
structure.emptyBody: Reporting groups organise income and expense accounts for planning and reports. Choose a quick start or build your own labels — nothing is locked to a template.
structure.applyTemplateCustomizeNote: You can rename, reorder, or extend everything after applying. The template is a one-time starter — not a permanent link.
structure.templateAppliedNextSteps: Starter structure applied. Review the groups, rename labels for your organisation, or add accounts where needed.
structure.viewOnlyHint: You can browse the financial structure. Changes require structure management permission.
structure.archivedHint: Archived items are kept for history and can be reactivated.
structure.confirmDeleteGroup: Permanently delete this reporting group? Remove child groups and accounts first.

generic_income_expense_v1.name: Generic income & expense
generic_income_expense_v1.description: Simple starter structure with separate income and expense sections.
generic_income_expense_v1.previewSummary: Creates two reporting groups with two sample accounts each. You can rename everything afterwards.

overview.notConfiguredBody: Set a base currency and financial year when you are ready. No sample data will be shown.
overview.incompleteBody: Complete base currency, at least one financial year, and confirm setup to unlock finance capabilities.
overview.configuredNoDataBody: Budgets, actuals, and reports will appear here as you enable capabilities and add data in future releases.
overview.configuredCapabilitiesBody: Enabled capabilities are available from the navigation. Postings and calculations are not part of this foundation release.
overview.setupWorkflowSubordinateBody: Base currency and a financial year are in place. Complete setup in settings when you are ready — the summary above stays visible.
overview.reportingNoCurrencyBody: Set a base currency in finance setup before budget totals can be interpreted.
overview.reportingNoFinanceYearBody: Create at least one financial year in finance setup so budget and reporting can be scoped to a year.
overview.reportingNoStructureBody: Management reporting uses your reporting groups and accounts. Define the structure before interpreting budget totals.
overview.reportingNoBaselineBody: Management reporting becomes available once a budget baseline is approved for the selected financial year. Draft planning does not appear here.

budget.pageDescription: Plan amounts against your financial accounts for a financial year. Approval establishes the protected baseline.
budget.currencyUnsetHint: Set a base currency in finance setup so planned amounts are unambiguous.
budget.selectYearHint: Choose a financial year to view or edit the budget.
budget.approveBlockedPendingSave: Save all planned amounts before approving the baseline.
budget.noYearBody: Define at least one financial year in finance setup before planning a budget.
budget.noAccountsBody: Create income and expense accounts in the financial structure builder before entering planned amounts.
budget.viewOnlyHint: You can review this budget. Draft changes require budget management permission.
budget.emptyBody: Create a working budget for this financial year.
budget.createDialogBody: Target: {year}. Choose how the new working budget should start.
budget.copySourceUnavailable: No prior financial year with an approved current baseline is available.
budget.createSuccessCopy: Budget created for {year}. {count} lines copied. Planned income: {income}. Planned expenses: {expense}.
budget.createSuccessCopyExcluded: {count} lines were not copied because the related accounts are archived.
budget.approveDialogBody: Approval establishes the financial baseline for this year. Approved amounts are protected from silent editing and support future actuals and forecasts.
budget.readinessReady: This working budget meets the prerequisites to establish the governance baseline.

readinessIssue.BASE_CURRENCY_REQUIRED: Configure organisation base currency in finance setup before approval.
readinessIssue.NO_PLANNED_LINES: Enter at least one planned amount on an account before approval.
readinessIssue.INVALID_LINE_AMOUNT: One or more planned amounts are invalid.
readinessIssue.LINE_ON_ARCHIVED_ACCOUNT: Some planned amounts reference archived accounts — review before approval.
readinessIssue.APPROVED_BASELINE_ALREADY_EXISTS: An approved baseline already exists for this financial year.
readinessIssue.NO_CURRENT_BASELINE_FOR_REBASELINE: No valid current baseline exists for re-baselining.
readinessIssue.VERSION_NOT_DRAFT: Only a working budget can be approved.

budget.rebaselineReadinessReady: This working revision can become the new governance baseline.
budget.rebaselineDialogBody: This working revision will become the financial baseline for this year. The previous approved baseline stays in version history. Reporting will use the new baseline afterward.
budget.workingRevisionHint: Changes below apply to the working revision only. Reporting and variance use the approved baseline until a future re-baseline.
budget.revisionStartBody: The approved baseline stays locked for reporting. Start a working revision to explore updated plans without changing the governance baseline.
budget.workingRevisionTotalsScope: Working revision totals — not the approved baseline

forecast.pageDescription: Current management forecast per financial year — independent of approved budget and actuals.
forecast.viewOnlyHint: Forecast is view-only. Editing requires forecast manage permission.
forecast.noYearBody: Create at least one financial year in finance setup.
forecast.noAccountsBody: Create income and expense accounts before entering forecast amounts.
forecast.emptyBody: Create the current management forecast for this financial year.
forecast.createModeEmptyDescription: Create a forecast with no starting amounts.
forecast.createModeFromBaselineDescription: Use current approved budget amounts as the starting point.
forecast.baselineUnavailableHint: Budget initialization requires an approved governance baseline.

projection.sectionDescription: Calculated automatically from your actuals and historical financial patterns.
projection.introBody: The automatic forecast is derived from your actuals and available historical finance data. Your current forecast remains independent.
projection.introExplainHint: After generation, you can trace how each automatic forecast amount was calculated.
projection.emptyBody: Create an automatic forecast once enough actual data is available for this financial year.
projection.insufficientBody: There is not yet enough actual data to calculate a reliable automatic forecast for this financial year.
projection.chartDivergenceDescription: Where the automatic forecast differs most from your current forecast.
projection.adoptSuccess: The automatic forecast was applied as a new version of your current forecast.
projection.adoptStaleBlocked: New financial data is available since this calculation. Refresh the automatic forecast first.
projection.adoptNoEligible: There are currently no reliable automatic forecast values that can be applied.
projection.adoptDialogDescription: Available automatic forecast values will become a new version of your current forecast. Positions without a reliable automatic forecast stay unchanged. The previous forecast remains in the version history.

actuals.pageDescription: Record measured income and expenses and compare them to the approved budget baseline.
actuals.periodBudgetReferenceSecondary: Annual budget as reference · No period budget variance without budget phasing
actuals.ytdBudgetReferenceSecondary: Annual budget as reference · No YTD budget variance without budget phasing
actuals.viewOnlyHint: You can view actuals. Recording and editing require actuals management permission.
actuals.ytdBudgetVarianceUnsupported: YTD budget variance is unavailable without budget phasing.
actuals.periodBudgetVarianceUnsupported: Period budget variance is unavailable without budget phasing.
actuals.noBaseCurrency: Configure a base currency in finance setup.
actuals.noFinanceYear: Create at least one financial year.

managementSignal.ACCOUNTS_WITH_ACTUAL_NO_BUDGET: Some accounts have actuals without an approved annual budget.
managementSignal.BUDGET_ACCOUNTS_WITHOUT_ACTUAL: Some budgeted accounts have no YTD actual activity yet.

actuals.noApprovedBaseline: No approved budget baseline — variance is meaningful after approval.
actuals.entriesEmpty: No actual entries for this financial year yet.
actuals.entriesEmptyYtd: No actual entries for YTD · {year} · through {date}.

settings.title: Finance setup
settings.description: Base currency, financial years, and enabled capabilities.
settings.structureOnlyHint: Configuration changes require finance admin permission.
settings.baseCurrencyHelp: ISO 4217 code used for organisation finance (not platform billing).
settings.baseCurrencyPlaceholder: Search ISO code or currency name…
settings.baseCurrencyRequiredStatus: Required — base currency is not configured yet
settings.financeYearHelp: Defines your organisation's financial periods — independent from sporting seasons.
settings.financeYearPeriodLocked: Dates are locked after an approved budget baseline exists. You can still rename this year.
settings.capabilitiesHelp: Choose which finance functions your organisation uses. These settings apply regardless of financial year and can be adjusted later.
settings.starterNudgeBody: Start with Overview. More finance functions will become available step by step and can be added at any time later.

capabilityDescriptions.OVERVIEW: Key financial metrics and your current financial position at a glance.
capabilityDescriptions.MANAGEMENT_INCOME_STATEMENT: Compare income and expenses to see surplus or deficit.
capabilityDescriptions.BUDGETING: Plan income and expenses and set budgets for the financial year.
capabilityDescriptions.ACTUALS: Record actual income and expenses and compare them with plans.
capabilityDescriptions.FORECASTING: Estimate expected financial development based on current figures.
capabilityDescriptions.COST_CENTERS: Organise and analyse finances by freely defined areas or other structures.
capabilityDescriptions.PROJECTS: Track budgets, income, and expenses for time-bound initiatives separately.
capabilityDescriptions.FUNDS: Manage funds earmarked or restricted for specific purposes.
capabilityDescriptions.RECEIVABLES: Track open income and see which payments are still outstanding.
capabilityDescriptions.PAYABLES: Keep sight of open expenses and upcoming payment obligations.
capabilityDescriptions.COMMITMENTS: Record planned obligations before they become expenses.
capabilityDescriptions.APPROVALS: Manage approvals for budgets and financial decisions.
capabilityDescriptions.PERSONNEL_FINANCE: Reflect personnel costs and budgets in financial planning.
capabilityDescriptions.EVENT_FINANCE: Follow income and expenses for individual events.
capabilityDescriptions.GRANTS: Manage and analyse grants and funding separately.
capabilityDescriptions.LIQUIDITY: Monitor available funds and expected cash flows.
capabilityDescriptions.ACCOUNTING_INTEGRATION: Exchange financial data with external accounting systems.
capabilityDescriptions.UNIT_ECONOMICS: Analyse costs and revenue per unit or service.
capabilityDescriptions.REPORTING: Prepare financial information for different audiences.
